project_name: RODE - Redone Output Data Entry (PT REDONE BERKAH MANDIRI)

scale.kpi_number: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold font-mono tracking-tight
scale.tv_huge_number: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black font-mono tracking-tighter

operator_pwa.header: Sticky header with PT REDONE BERKAH MANDIRI logo, active operator badge, shift info, and live clock (WIB)
operator_pwa.plus_one_button: h-36 sm:h-44 w-full rounded-2xl bg-[#0A2463] hover:bg-[#061842] active:scale-95 text-white shadow-xl shadow-navy-900/20 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 border-2 border-blue-400/30 transition-all cursor-pointer select-none touch-manipulation
operator_pwa.block_grid: Grid of 45-minute blocks for 8-hour shift. Each block displays: Time interval (e.g. 08:00-08:45), Target vs Actual count, Status color indicator with icon and tooltip. Click block to select active block or view details.
operator_pwa.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom navigation bar (Input, Riwayat, Profil) with active state in `#0A2463` and `#3CAEA3` highlight indicator.

manager_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation + top header + main bento content area
manager_dashboard.kpi_cards: Grid of KPI cards (Sewing, Printing, Packing today total, Target, Achievement %, Active Lines count, Top Product, Last Updated timestamp)
manager_dashboard.idle_line_alert: Banner highlight for idle lines (>15 mins without input) with status pulse indicator
manager_dashboard.charts_section: Target vs Actual hourly bar chart, Department comparative line chart, Daily trend chart
manager_dashboard.tables: Interactive product and line performance table with status badges and quick sorting

smart_tv_board.theme: Full-screen dark mode (`bg-[#070F26]`) high contrast for shop floor viewability from 10 meters
smart_tv_board.components: Header with live status badge ('SISTEM LIVE' green pulse), server timestamp, shift info. Grid of line cards showing line leader, product name, block grid status, total achievement percentage bar, and hourly target vs actual.

super_admin.tabs: Departments, Production Lines, Products, User Accounts, Shift Schedules & Breaks, Target Matrix, Smart TV Display Tokens, Audit Log
super_admin.ui_components: Shadcn Table, Dialog form modals, Select, Switch, Tooltip, Sonner Toast for confirmation actions

accessibility_and_localization.color_blind_support: Status indicators MUST use both distinct colors AND Lucide icons + text labels
accessibility_and_localization.data_testid_rule: All buttons, inputs, tabs, KPI items, line blocks, dialogs, and navigation links MUST include data-testid (kebab-case)

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Use primary Navy #0A2463 for dominant branding and key CTAs, paired with Teal #3CAEA3 for progress & highlights.
Mobile operator view must have a prominent +1 PCS button with touch-manipulation and active feedback.
Ensure all block status grids explicitly show state via color, label text, and icon for complete accessibility.
Smart TV board must be high contrast dark mode (#070F26 background) with huge readable numbers for shop floor view.
Include data-testid on all interactive and data display elements for testing compliance.
